verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents trace retention periods, TTL settings, or the ability to delete traces or data in LangSmith. Self-hosting (langsmith-docs-48) keeps data in your own environment, but that is data residency, an adjacent control, not retention or deletion control. Data retention is a fair question for an observability platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
